quest.title: Hydrological Investigation in The Chasm
quest.description: You fish up something strange in The Chasm. What in the world could it be? According to the Sumeru scholar Khedive, just place it by the water and you will discover its secret...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x90000

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the strange object...

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Did you fish this up from the water? Hmm. Actually, at first glance, this thing does look like a fishing bait.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Is it normal for people to come across this kind of stuff while fishing? Anisa never misses a single day fishing on Watatsumi Island, but she's never discovered anything special.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Perhaps it's the fisher that makes the difference, then?

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Let me check. Mm, I can sense an incredibly high concentration of Hydro energy within it.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: The groundwater in The Chasm does contain unusually rich elemental power. Does that have anything to do with things like this growing within it?

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: But ever since you fished it up, its elemental energy has been ebbing away. Maybe we need to place it by the water to see what its power is capable of.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Place it by the water?

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Yes, and also activate it with Hydro energy. I suspect that it'll reveal its secrets to us then.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: How about you go activate it? — I mean, since you're the one who fished it up and all. Let me know if you get any results.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: I'll pay you if your findings are of academic value.

talks.objective: Place the strange object by the water
Use Hydro reactions to activate the strange object
Defeat the Hydro Geovishap that emerged
Tell Khedive about what happened by the water

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the strange object by the water...

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Huh? Have you placed it by the water?

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: How is it? Did anything special happen?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A Geovishap showed up.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: A Geovishap? It turned into a Geovishap in the water!?

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Oh, you mean that it didn't turn into a Geovishap, but rather, attracted one over.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: My heart almost stopped there! If it really had turned into a Geovishap, my whole world-view would have been shattered.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So what exactly is that thing?

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: The answer is simple. How should I put it? Mmm, well why don't you tell me first if there was anything special about that Geovishap?

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Did it, say, wield Hydro?

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: That Geovishap is probably able to use Hydro.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: The groundwater in The Chasm contains dense Hydro energies. As such, certain high-concentration spots have become the nurturing grounds for the waterweed-like object that you fished up.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: The Geovishap — and other water-loving creatures in The Chasm, too — has increased its power by feeding on these waterweeds that are rich in Hydro.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: So that thing is... just some waterweed rich in Hydro elements!

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Yep, waterweed — only that it contains exceedingly dense Hydro elemental energy.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: You don't usually find it in ordinary environments — unless some immense, pure power has altered the source of the water... Forget it, these waterweeds...

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: It could turn into sentient elemental beings one day. You know what? This would make a fine research topic.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: #You must've taken it out too quickly to notice its special trait. How impressive, as expected of the legendary {NICKNAME}.
